name: Slumber Party
source:
Three online friends have been playing an online game together and they finally manage to arrange an meet-up!! What will happen? Friend things? Gay things?? Who knows??? You know if you play the game.

[From [url=https://littanana.itch.io/slumber-party]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三个网友一直一起玩网络游戏，终于成功约好了见面！接下来会发生什么？朋友之间的事？男同性恋之间的事？谁知道呢？玩了游戏你就会知道。

（来源：[url=https://littanana.itch.io/slumber-party]itch.io[/url]）
